title: Chia tải 4 mảnh kiểm thử Playwright song song với Matrix Sharding
code:
strategy:
  fail-fast: false
  matrix:
    shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
steps:
  - run: npx playwright test --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/4

title: Thăm dò cổng sẵn sàng thay thế lệnh sleep cảm tính
code:
- name: Wait for API readiness
  run: |
    npm start &
    curl --fail --retry 15 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 2 http://localhost:3000/healthz
